# === dif/2 — Disequality constraint ===

--8<-- [start:semantics]
dif(X, Y), X = 1, Y = 2    % succeeds: 1 and 2 differ
--8<-- [end:semantics]

--8<-- [start:semantics_ex2]
dif(X, Y), X = 1, Y = 1    % fails: dif violated when Y = 1
--8<-- [end:semantics_ex2]

--8<-- [start:semantics_ex3]
dif(X, 1), dif(X, 2), X = 3    % succeeds: 3 differs from 1 and 2
dif(X, 1), dif(X, 2), X = 1    % fails: dif(X, 1) violated
--8<-- [end:semantics_ex3]

--8<-- [start:semantics_ex4]
X \= Y    % fails if X and Y are both unbound (they CAN unify)
--8<-- [end:semantics_ex4]


# === CLP(B) — Boolean Constraints ===

--8<-- [start:syntax_examples]
sat(X & Y)                # both must be 1
sat(X | Y)                # at least one must be 1
sat(~X)                    # X must be 0
sat(BoolEq(X, Y))         # X ↔ Y (equivalence)
sat(BoolImpl(X, Y))       # X → Y (implication)
--8<-- [end:syntax_examples]

--8<-- [start:syntax_examples_ex2]
taut(BoolEq(~(X & Y), ~X | ~Y), T)   # T = 1
--8<-- [end:syntax_examples_ex2]

--8<-- [start:syntax_examples_ex3]
sat_count(X ^ Y, N)       # N = 2
sat_count(X & Y, N)       # N = 1
sat_count(X | Y, N)       # N = 3
--8<-- [end:syntax_examples_ex3]


# === CLP(ℝ) — Real-domain Constraints ===

--8<-- [start:unified_dispatch]
% A float literal makes this a CLP(R) constraint
:- use_module(library(clpz)).

sqrt2(X) :-
    in_real(X, 0.0, 2.0),
    X * X #= 2.0,
    label_real([X], 1.0e-12).
% X's interval is narrowed to 1.4142135623730951 (within 1.0e-12)
--8<-- [end:unified_dispatch]
